interview.hardest_part: Converting a broad development plan into enough completed milestones within three hours, using one screenshot and one physical input at a time. Research, expansion, construction and defense must stay coordinated without spending excessive time navigating menus. These are subjective forecasts, not measured performance estimates; I have not seen the starting map or interaction latency.
interview.likely_failure: Running out of wall-clock time with later technologies and buildings still unfinished, rather than outright military defeat. Misreading a selected unit, overlooking a blocked production choice, or repeatedly correcting movement orders could compound into substantial lost time. I would prioritize completed scoring milestones over pursuing an actual Science Victory.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The stated turn-based setup prevents enemies from advancing turns while I deliberate, and the milestone scoring allows substantial credit without winning. Aztec Builders can contribute 20% of a district's production cost per charge, accelerating district completion. ([civilization.fandom.com](https://civilization.fandom.com/wiki/Aztec_%28Civ6%29?utm_source=openai)) Eagle Warriors can turn defeated eligible enemy units into Builders, potentially supporting both defense and development. ([civilization.fandom.com](https://civilization.fandom.com/wiki/Aztec_%28Civ6%29?utm_source=openai))
interview.harmful_mechanics: Population gates specialty districts, so collecting the required infrastructure demands growth and multiple cities. ([civilopedia.net](https://www.civilopedia.net/en-US/standard-rules/concepts/cities_10/?utm_source=openai)) Barracks and Stables are mutually exclusive within one Encampment, requiring separate cities to obtain both. ([civilopedia.net](https://www.civilopedia.net/en-US/standard-rules/buildings/building_stable/)) Crucially, the Aztec Tlachtli replaces the Arena: I cannot assume it satisfies an exact BUILDING_ARENA check. This potential scoring incompatibility, alongside the time limit, makes full marks extremely unlikely. ([civilization.fandom.com](https://civilization.fandom.com/wiki/Tlachtli_%28Civ6%29?utm_source=openai))
